member.name: M:HearthDb.Cards.LoadBaseData

Load base card data, this should usually be a CardDefs.base.xml file, that at least includes all non-localized metadata.
This will clear any previously loaded data.

member.name: M:HearthDb.Cards.LoadBaseData(HearthDb.CardDefs.CardDefs)
member.summary:
Load base card data, this should usually be a CardDefs.base.xml file, that at least includes all non-localized metadata.
This will clear any previously loaded data.

member.name: M:HearthDb.Cards.LoadLocaleData(System.IO.Stream,HearthDb.Enums.Locale)

member.name: M:HearthDb.Cards.LoadLocaleData(HearthDb.CardDefs.CardDefs,HearthDb.Enums.Locale)
member.summary: Load additional locale specific card data (names, text, ...). LoadBaseData() must have been previously called if Config.AutoLoadCardDefs (enabled by default) was disabled.

member.name: M:HearthDb.Cards.TryGetTripleId(System.String)

member.name: P:HearthDb.Config.AutoLoadCardDefs
member.summary: Automatically and synchronously load card data included with HearthDB. By default, this will be all non-localized card metadata, as well as localized strings in enUS and zhCN. If disabled, card data needs to be explicitly loaded via HearthDb.Cards.LoadBaseData

member.name: P:HearthDb.Deckstrings.Deck.HeroDbfId
member.summary: DbfId of the hero. Required. This can be a specific hero for a class, i.e. Medivh over Jaina.

member.name: P:HearthDb.Deckstrings.Deck.CardDbfIds
member.summary: Dictionary of (DbfId, Count) for each card. Needs to be a total of 30 cards to be accepted by Hearthstone.

member.name: P:HearthDb.Deckstrings.Deck.Sideboards
member.summary: Dictionary of (owner DbfId, Dictionary of (DbfId, Count)) for each card in each sideboard.

member.name: P:HearthDb.Deckstrings.Deck.Format
member.summary: Format of the deck. Required.

member.name: P:HearthDb.Deckstrings.Deck.ZodiacYear
member.summary: Year of the deck format. Optional.

member.name: P:HearthDb.Deckstrings.Deck.Name
member.summary: Name of the deck. Optional.

member.name: P:HearthDb.Deckstrings.Deck.DeckId
member.summary: Hearthstones internal ID of the deck. Optional.

member.name: M:HearthDb.Deckstrings.Deck.GetHero
member.summary: Gets the card object for the given HeroDbfId

member.summary: Converts (OwnerDbfId, (DbfId, Count)) dictionary to (OwnerCardObject, (CardObject, Count)).
